column1: # Babi's audience, part II: the Draught of Lemuria, Babi's failing supply, and the search for the lost city.

column3: The Stone of Sages?{pause_20_skippable}\nA stone that grants\neternal life?{end_wait}
How else could Babi\nhave lived for\nso many years?{end_wait}
I know the stories.\nBut I do not have\nthe Stone of Sages.{end_wait}
The Draught of Lemuria\nhas kept me alive\nall this time.{end_wait}
The Draught of Lemuria?{end_wait}
A rare drink made\nin Lemuria, long ago.{end_wait}
Then it stops\npeople from aging?{end_wait}
No. It only slows\nthe passing of years{pause_20_skippable}.{end_wait}
Lemurians still die.\nThey merely live\nlonger than we do.{end_wait}
Their lives can span\ncenturies, while\ntheir senses fade.{end_wait}
Do Lemurians use\nPsynergy, as we do?{end_wait}
You have the draught,\nBabi. That is how you\nhave lived so long.{end_wait}
With that time,\nI built my fortune\nand came to rule.{end_wait}
What are you suggesting?{end_wait}
Then why do you\nhave scholars working\non Alchemy?{end_wait}
I've wondered that\nmyself. What is Babi\nhoping to find?{end_wait}
If I had found a way\nto live forever,\nwould I need them?{end_wait}
I have little draught\nleft. Every drop\nmatters now.{end_wait}
You saw it in the cave.\nOnly a small amount\nremained.{end_wait}
What happens when\nthe last of it\nis gone?{end_wait}
Then I will die.\nI have no reason\nto hide that now.{end_wait}
Why didn't you\ntell us sooner?\nWe must act!{end_wait}
What do you mean,\nthere is no point?{end_wait}
I have searched\nfor Lemuria for years.\nStill, nothing.{end_wait}
But you said it lies\nfar out at sea...{end_wait}
Then let's send\nanother ship!\nThere must be a way!{end_wait}
I have sent ships.\nMore than I care\nto remember.{end_wait}
I was not here then.\nBut every voyage failed?{end_wait}
I needed more draught.\nEvery voyage failed\nto reach Lemuria.{end_wait}
Then why did you\ncollapse in Altmiller\nCave?{end_wait}
I waited too long\nbetween doses.\nI feared wasting it.{end_wait}
You were trying\nto make it last...{end_wait}
I kept searching\nas my supply ran low.\nIt was never enough.{end_wait}
So you called us here\nto find Lemuria\nfor you?{end_wait}
Yes. I need you\nto find what\nmy ships could not.{end_wait}
The sea has failed me.\nI hoped a view\nfrom above might help.{end_wait}
That's why I built\nBabi Lighthouse.\nTo search for Lemuria.{end_wait}
You built a lighthouse\njust to search\nthe sea?{end_wait}
There is something\nelse you must hear.{end_wait}
A shape stirred\nsoutheast in the sea...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nwhere Lemuria should lie.{end_wait}
